title: Vacuum actuator with integrated pressure sensor

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph 1) The reference describes an integrated pneumatic pressure transducer with a vacuum actuator for controlling actuators in an internal combustion engine, which implies a vacuum generation mechanism, but it does not specify an electric vacuum pump or its mounting within a rigid body for a lifting device.
features.quote_src: Die Erfindung bezieht sich auf eine integrierte Druckwandler-Unterdruck-Stelleinheit, insbesondere auf einen integrierten pneumatischen Druckwandler mit einem Unterdrucksteller zum Ansteuern von Stellern an einer Verbrennungskraftmaschine.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a pressure transducer (Druckwandler) that connects a chamber to vacuum and atmospheric pressure levels, indicating it monitors or controls pressure levels.
features.quote_src: Integrierte Druckwandler-Unterdruck-Stelleinheit (14) mit einem Druckwandler (10) mit einer Kammer (68), die mit einem Unterdruckniveau p<vac> und dem Atmosphärendruckniveau p<ATM> verbindbar ist

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord

overall.why: The reference describes an integrated pressure transducer and vacuum actuator unit, which is a component of a vacuum system, but not a complete vacuum lifting device.
